summary: This file is a configuration dictionary (no callable functions/classes). It defines model settings for a HorNet-tiny ImageClassifier using MMClassification conventions, including backbone, classification head, initialization, and training augmentations.
config_model: configure an ImageClassifier with a HorNet tiny backbone and LinearClsHead for 1000 classes
config_backbone: configure a HorNet tiny architecture backbone with 0.2 drop path rate
config_head: configure a LinearClsHead with LabelSmoothLoss and 512 input channels
config_init: configure truncated normal and constant initialization for Linear, LayerNorm, and LayerScale layers
config_train_augments: configure Mixup and CutMix data augmentation settings for training
